rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to unplug before opening the drain filter and the filter clean is one small part of the real fix, but it framed the whole problem as an airflow blockage and a condenser lint trap ('these models often have a condenser unit that also traps lint') rather than biofilm from cold washes, excess softener and a shut door.
